feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 July 2026 4:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 22 July 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or Northwest, mainly 4 or 5, but occasionally increasing 6 in the west of the area for a time this evening and at first tonight. Also, decreasing Variable 2 or 3 tomorrow afternoon in the southwest of the area, towards Dublin Bay.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at times.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5 at first, but Variable 2 or 3 in the southwest of the area, then becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters overnight into Friday. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
